shell.noAccess: You do not have access to any admin screens. Ask your administrator to update your role.

changePassword.title: Change your password
changePassword.intro: You must choose a new password before you continue.

validation.passwordLength: Use 10 to 128 characters, or leave empty to generate one.
validation.empCode: Use letters, digits, '-', '_' or '/' (up to 32 characters).
validation.mobile: Enter a valid mobile number (10 to 15 digits).

errors.GENERIC: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.NETWORK: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE: The server could not be reached. Please try again shortly.
errors.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} minute(s), or ask your administrator to unlock the account.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} minute(s).
errors.PASSWORD_UNCHANGED: Choose a password different from the current one.
errors.DUPLICATE: That employee code, mobile number or email is already in use.
errors.HAS_REPORTS: This employee still has active reports. Reassign them before deactivating.
errors.LAST_SUPER_ADMIN: There must be at least one active Super Admin.
errors.MANAGER_CYCLE: An employee cannot report to themselves or to their own team.
errors.IN_USE: This item is still in use.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some of the details are not valid. Check the form and try again.
errors.INVALID_REFERENCE: One of the selected options no longer exists. Reload and try again.
errors.INVALID_FILE: The file could not be read. Upload a UTF-8 CSV or an Excel (.xlsx) file.
errors.CONFLICT: This action is no longer possible. Reload and try again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: Not found. It may have been removed.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has expired. Sign in again.

employees.title: Employees
employees.search: Search by name, code or mobile
employees.createHint: If you leave the password empty, a temporary one is generated.
employees.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate {{name}}? They will be signed out and cannot sign in again until reactivated.
employees.reactivateConfirm: Reactivate {{name}}? They will be able to sign in again.
employees.resetConfirm: Generate a new temporary password for {{name}}? Their current password stops working and they are signed out.

form.name: Full name
form.passwordHint: Leave empty to generate a temporary password.

temporaryPassword.title: Temporary password
temporaryPassword.label: Temporary password
temporaryPassword.warning: Share this temporary password with the employee securely. It is shown only once and cannot be retrieved later. The employee must change it at first sign in.

import.title: Import employees
import.description: Upload an Excel (.xlsx) or CSV file. The file is checked first; nothing is created until you confirm.
import.passwordWarning: This file contains temporary passwords. Delete the downloaded file after you have distributed the passwords. The passwords are shown only once, are not stored by the system and cannot be retrieved later.

devices.title: Devices
devices.approveConfirm: Approve {{model}} for {{name}}? This revokes the employee's current phone, which is signed out at once.
devices.revokeConfirm: Revoke {{model}} for {{name}}? The phone is signed out and cannot punch in.
